reason: The README clearly describes an image-to-text bridge that lets text-only models process images through a configured vision model, with generated descriptions inserted into the model-visible conversation.

summaries.zh: 为纯文本模型调用配置的视觉模型，将会话中的图片转换为文字描述并提供自动或手动识图能力。
summaries.en: Bridges images to text-only models by using a configured vision model to generate descriptions automatically or through a manual image-description tool.

capabilities: Detects image inputs in model requests
Sends images to a configured vision model for textual description
Replaces model-visible image content with generated descriptions while retaining the original in human transcripts
Provides a manual image-description tool and configurable vision-model routing
